newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso gains 2.5 vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso gains 2.5 vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso gained 2.5 pesos to close at 1,068 in a day of steady trading in which signs of recent volatility began to dissipate, interbank traders said.
The peso rebound comes after recent heavy falls driven by emergency economic measures and a wave of speculation.
Interbank traders there was slight demand for greenbacks from industry coupled with an inflow of dollar export earnings from the coffee sector.
Dealers reported 413 operations worth a total $165 million. The peso sank to an intraday low of 1,073.2 and hit a high of 1,066.7 pesos against the dollar.
